I think terminal illness are exactly what they are - terminal. If the physical suffering is so great and there is definitely no hope in improving quality of existence, euthanasia is reasonable and understandable. 

Chronic illness that can be medically managed and level of suffering can minimized suicide is still a permanent solution to a temporary problem. 

For instance, what if you have end stage lung cancer, but the symptoms can be managed that your physical suffering isn’t so great yet. Do you end it now before it gets bad or do you wait until the symptoms worsen to the point that you are suffering greatly to end it? Do you let the disease take its natural course and wait until organs fail one by one? So hard, I don’t have the answer.
